Finds markets by words in their title, e.g. bitcoin or election, one item per market.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `polymarket.search` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Search for (`query`) | text | yes |  | Words in the event title. |
| Limit (`limit`) | whole number | no | `10` | Most markets to return. |
| Closed markets (`closed`) | true or false | no | `false` | Search closed markets instead of open ones. |
